## BRAND SYSTEM DEPLOYMENT — 2026-08-13
The current canonical Al Sidr brand system has been saved as a Google Drive ZIP package named **Al Sidr Natural Honey — Brand Operating System.zip** and as a Google Doc named **Al Sidr Natural Honey — Brand Core Knowledge Base**.

The package contains the canonical knowledge base, four validated Manus skills, agent roster and handoffs, bilingual copy and support templates, design tokens, brand manifest, implementation-ready HTML/CSS, and prioritized growth ideas.

### Applied operating rules
- Use the Sweet Response Framework: Education → Personalization → Clear Direction.
- Use a premium, confident, authentic, warm, restrained, and culturally elegant voice.
- Write natural English and culturally appropriate Arabic as separate versions.
- Do not invent live prices, stock, delivery times, promotions, retailer availability, awards, certifications, order status, or customer details.
- Do not make medical, diagnostic, therapeutic, cure, detox, or guaranteed claims.
- Route customers to https://alsidrnaturalhoney.com, https://alsidrnaturalhoney.com/ar, https://wa.me/message/GL7KBRRYQQAPN1, or a confirmed Abu Dhabi location.
- Require human review before live publication, paid advertising, price changes, B2B terms, sensitive support replies, or production deployment.

### Connected-app application status
The shared package and brand core are persisted in Google Workspace. Existing Notion structures remain canonical; do not create parallel dashboards or duplicate operating systems. App-specific publication to Instagram, Meta Ads, Shopify, Slack, Canva, Airtable, Asana, Linear, Close, Zapier, Vercel, Wix, or Cloudflare requires a selected destination and a separate approved workflow.
